newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH INSURER RAISES BASIC CAPITAL CZK 1.14 BLN. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CZECH INSURER RAISES BASIC CAPITAL CZK 1.14 BLN. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s. on Thursday said it had riased its basic capital by 1.14 billion crowns to 3.41 billion in the first round of a share rights issue.

In a statement, Pojistovna said 968,575 shares of the 1.137 billion available, each with a nominal value of 1,000 crowns, were subscribed in the first round, which was open at rate of one new share for each two shares current shareholders hold.
In addition to the nominal value, participants in the round paid a premium of 4,000 (corrects from 4,00) crowns per share.
The statement added that Pojistovna's main shareholders -- banks CSOB, IPB and Komercni Banka, the National Property Fund (NPF), and investment fund PPF all exercised their full option on the issue.
"The second subscription round, which is open to those who participated in the first round, begins November 25 and ends November 26," the statement said.
If all shares are not subscribed to in the second round, a third round, open to the public, will be held on November 27 and 28, the statement said.
